site: Jezero crater — Octavia E. Butler landing site and surroundings

credits.text: Derived from HiRISE DTM; relative GCR/SPE exposure proxy, not a dose
THEMIS day/night IR controlled mosaics 100 m (NASA/JPL/ASU) via JPL Mars Trek; relative day-night swing index, not a temperature
HiRISE DTM mosaic (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona/USGS) via JPL Mars Trek
Derived from HiRISE DTM: local relief residual (2 m), p90 per 10 m cell
Derived from HiRISE orthomosaic: local brightness contrast per 10 m cell (relative)

Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, Geologic map of Jezero crater and the Nili Planum region, Mars: U.S. Geological Survey Scientific Investigations Map 3464, pamphlet 14 p., 1 sheet, scale 1:75,000, https://doi.org/10.3133/sim3464.

NASA Mars 2020 Science Team photogeologic map on HiRISE (Stack et al. 2020, Space Sci. Rev. 216:127, doi:10.1007/s11214-020-00739-x): talus and exposed blocky-bedrock units, area fraction per 10 m cell

Patch labels from NASA data by fixed rules (written with SI, see docs/SI_USAGE.md): slope >= 20° (NASA EVA limit), Mars 2020 photogeologic and in situ maps (Stack et al. 2020; Crumpler et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0), Perseverance drive path (NASA/JPL-Caltech); MLP classifier on HiRISE DTM slope/roughness and orthomosaic texture (relative hazard, not a rock count)

HiRISE orthomosaic (NASA/JPL/University of Arizona) via JPL Mars Trek; colour from the Mars 2020 HiRISE RGB + CTX basemap (NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona) via Mars 2020 MMGIS, extended by grey-level matching outside its footprint; near-camera tiles from the same orthomosaic at Trek zoom 17 (~0.32 m/px)

Rover-mode hazard: patch labels from NASA data by fixed rules without the slope rule (written with SI, see docs/SI_USAGE.md): Mars 2020 photogeologic and in situ maps (Stack et al. 2020; Crumpler et al. 2023, CC BY 4.0), Perseverance drive path (NASA/JPL-Caltech); MLP on HiRISE DTM roughness and orthomosaic texture (no slope features); impassable = mapped ripples plus hazard-model cells not explained by slope
